body:
## What this is

This listing is a flexible private car charter that covers Japan's major regions, including Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya and Hokkaido. You can book it as a one-way transfer, a one-day charter or a multi-day charter, and either build your own itinerary or follow a recommended route.

## How the booking works

After booking, you confirm the itinerary directly with the charter provider through the KKday app. The first option shown is a private transfer with consultation after purchase, priced at US$0.08, which is a placeholder for the inquiry; the custom charter option started at US$632.52 for a booking where you include an inquiry number, travel date and itinerary summary.

## Vehicles and capacity

The listing offers five vehicles: a luxury 7-seater, and comfy 10-, 14-, 21- and 30-seaters. The luxury 7-seater is described as a Toyota Alphard or equivalent for five or six passengers with four 24-inch bags; the 10- and 14-seaters use a Toyota Hiace or equivalent; the 21-seater is a Toyota Coaster or equivalent; the 30-seater is a medium bus.

## Hours and overtime

A charter day is 10 hours for 7- to 14-seat vehicles and 9 hours for larger ones, starting as early as 8:00 and ending by 22:00. Overtime is paid on site at 5,000 JPY per hour for 7 to 14 seats, 10,000 JPY for 21 seats and 12,000 JPY for 30 seats.

## Language and limits

The driver language is Chinese or Japanese, and the driver does not accompany passengers into sites. Free cancellation applies up to 3 days before the date.

## What to check

Because the price is agreed after you describe your route, get the total in writing in the app before the date. It is not a fixed package, so compare quotes if cost matters.

## When it fits

It suits groups with a specific route that does not fit public transport, such as several regional stops over a few days.
